On 64-bit platforms, a string of 4 GiB (2^32 bytes) or larger had its length wrap, so SQLite saw only the first `length mod 2^32` bytes. articles.title: GHSA: @hono/node-server: Unhandled `ECONNRESET` on the socket during an asynchronous WebSocket upgrade crashes the process
articles.summary:
### Summary

While `@hono/node-server` waits for the Hono application to handle a WebSocket upgrade request, the socket has no error listener. If the client resets the TCP connection during that time, the resulting `ECONNRESET` is emitted as an unhandled `'error'` event and the process terminates.

### Details

The upgrade handler awaits the application before attaching any listener to the socket.
